## Shared standards

Every completed public page needs one accurate H1, unique title/description, production self-canonical, parseable justified schema and appropriate internal links/alt text. Staging host remains noindex; workflows/rights holds are excluded from the sitemap. No Google ranking claim. Homepage content/images/interaction are protected. General policy links: Terms, Refund, Privacy; specific guides should carry relevant summary and full-policy links rather than repeat all clauses.

Button records below are a **static contract inventory**, not a new claim of successful clicks. Previous release QA is at QA_REPORT.md; no browser or live integration testing rerun in this documentation-only audit. Every rendered anchor and button is listed (including shared navigation); hidden/conditional controls may appear in the inventory. HTTP/contact reachability is not inferred from an href.

Error/mobile contracts: normal links retain native browser behaviour; local render/destination failures must not show fake success; menu/dropdown actions must remain keyboard-operable and use responsive touch targets. Form controls must validate, preserve inputs after errors, prevent duplicates and acknowledge only actual provider success; touch scrolling must not be blocked. Unsupported uploads/payments remain disabled/absent.

## Page-family audience and completeness contracts

| Page family | Intended audience | Required content / actions / forms | Missing evidence / review |
|---|---|---|---|
| Four services | Customers deciding which service fits their need | Scope, feasibility, Standard/VIP selection, relevant guide and quotation journey; no extra top-level services | Actual service methods/limits not supplied must not be inferred |
| Design-choice and Standard categories | Tailoring customer choosing design source | Exactly Standard/Special; Men's/Women's categories; retained experience and back navigation | Further licensed references need permission evidence |
| Galleries/design details | Customers browsing an authorised reference | Existing ref/image/details, request action preserving reference; truthful rights hold where unapproved | No invented product/stock/price; held pages not advertised as products |
| Special enquiry/request | Customers with their own design or a selected website reference | Name/contact, location, garment description/quantity, optional fabric/date/measurements, editable experience/design/priority/after-hours, review and real submit; files disabled | No approved private file endpoint; actual receipt unverified |
| Fabric Guide | Customers deciding fabric/colour | Local label distinction, stock/colour checks, agreed alternatives, quotation impact and relevant Terms | Reported price/tier data remains internal until clearance; research not composition |
| Measurements Guide | Customers preparing measurements/fittings | Preparation, assistance, incomplete data, company/customer errors, correction request and Terms | Exact detailed instructions and supplied-measurement assistance need original evidence |
| Customer information | Customers understanding commitment and timing | Ten-stage workflow, payment scope, confirmation vs start/completion, availability/priority and support links | Exact authorised exceptions/international/Special terms need confirmation |
| Delivery/collection | Customers arranging garment handover | Address/appointment/payment/proof, third-party authority, rescheduling, free storage, policy links | Exact company-caused missed-delivery remedy missing |
| Benefits | Qualifying suit customers/referrers | Narrow eligibility/rates, nonstacking, relevant conditions and assistance route | Attribution/payout/gift/cleaning procedural details unresolved |
| Support/contact | Customers asking about a service or existing request | Exactly four service topics, concise contact/message, validation/consent/review where applicable; real contact alternatives | Actual provider receipt and processing details unverified |
| About/Our Work | Customers verifying identity and relevant work | Verified company/brand/location and evidenced projects only; service/contact links | No invented history/awards/testimonials; full source rights still required |
| Terms | Customers considering acceptance | Supported general customer rules with linked Refund/Privacy/guides, customer rights preserved | Rwanda legal review and missing specific clauses; no final VIP contract |
| Refund | Customers requesting assessment | Submit→assess→communicate→decision→approved processing→further review; working text request interface | Fabric-unavailability exception, amounts/cancellation/deadlines not final |
| Privacy | Customers understanding actual data handling | Actual operator/form/host/messaging/storage facts and contact route, explicit draft limitations | Retention/agreements/transfers/rights/legal verification not complete |
| General FAQ | Customers needing a concise approved answer | Source-equivalent short explanations and link to relevant full page | No new rules, final VIP FAQ or inferred legal terms |
| Legacy/held routes | Customers arriving on an older link | Truthful status and related meaningful navigation, no fake submission/order | Historical detail and image rights need review; local existence is not live acceptance |
